triples.tail_surface: accessible at all times for maintenance
triples.evidence_text: For single common-main bilge systems, the control valves required in the branches from the bilge main are to be accessible at all times for maintenance.

triples.tail_surface: multiple common-main bilge systems arranged such that any single control valve failure will not disable the bilge pumping capability from any one space
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 多总管舱底系统布置使任一单阀故障不致丧失排水能力
triples.evidence_text: This accessibility is not required for multiple common-main bilge systems arranged such that any single control valve failure will not disable the bilge pumping capability from any one space.

triples.tail_surface: drainage arrangements are to be such as to prevent the build-up of free surfaces
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 排水布置应防止自由液面积聚
triples.evidence_text: Where the cargo space is fitted with a fixed water-spray fire extinguishing system, the drainage arrangements are to be such as to prevent the build-up of free surfaces.
